Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the chronological comparison. Despite correctly noting Joseph J. Magliocco was born in 1957 and Viktoriya Zeynep Güneş in 1998, the Planner concluded that Joseph was born later. In fact, 1998 is later than 1957, so Viktoriya Zeynep Güneş was born later.
